correctness.rationale: Backward generator and Bernoulli collision conditions uniquely determine first two absorption-time moments. The rational midpoint first moment agrees exactly with the archival telegraph formula under parameter conversion. The derivative at fixed capture sum is \((1-2\xi)(4-Q+2Q\xi)/[Q+(2\xi-1)P]^2\), with strictly positive remaining factor. The product feasible range is exactly \([\max\{0,Q-1\},Q^2/4]\). At the critical rate the derived exact variance is \((96-32Q-11Q^2+32P)/(6Q^2)\), strictly increasing in P. Global boundary cases Q=2 and reversal rate zero are handled; separate exact symbolic substitution and seeded trajectories corroborated the proof.

value.rationale: A global allocation transition at mean free path equal to full corridor length is a natural finite-speed capture design law; the fact that *all* allocations tie exactly at threshold and the nontrivial sharp variance penalty resolves robustness that mean-only design cannot distinguish. The penalty \(4h^2/(3v^2)\) is budget-independent for every \(0<Q\le1\), not a numerical or arbitrary-slice result. The result is restricted to clearly stated stochastic and cost assumptions; no broader physical interpretation is inferred.
